reviewType: independent second editorial recheck of revised Explore candidates
status: 18 entries acceptable for candidate editing; 2 required revisions; not user tested
method: Read Chinese and English question/option content and infer the selection operation before examining the stated mapping reasons. Then compare with prior independent concerns and revisions. This is a review of preference comparability, not a search for a correct preference.
remainingLimitations: 09 task choices now cover two source-checking tasks and two preparation-of-guidance tasks, across rest, hydration and hygiene. This is a real improvement over four identical checks, but still samples general health information work rather than all health/welfare activities.

Task stems repeat the same comparability assumptions across community projects. They make the scope explicit, but the twenty responses do not establish stable field preferences or psychometric validity.
Opportunity counts support editorial coverage only. They do not justify an otherwise unnatural mapping, the required lens001 contextual repair, or a personality result.
